about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Discovery Sport D180 ENGINE
paragraphs: The Discovery Sport D180 was part of the L550-generation model's diesel lineup from 2019 to 2020. It uses the Ingenium AJ200D — a 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel that was also fitted to the D150 and D240 variants in the same generation. In 2020, the D180 was replaced by the D165 as part of a diesel range simplification. The Ingenium AJ200D is known for timing chain tensioner wear and oil dilution from DPF regeneration — a pattern shared across most Ingenium diesel engines of this era, which is why we address these components as standard during every rebuild.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace Ingenium AJ200D engines for every Discovery Sport D180 on the road.
